description: Book a confirmed guest slot on a PitchIQ host's PUBLIC booking calendar (Calendly-style). Outcome-priced — you pay per confirmed booking. Re-checks slot availability, sends the confirmation email, and pushes to the host's Google Calendar when connected. Find bookable hosts via discover_search_podcasts. x402-payable; no PAT required.

attendee_email.description: Guest email — receives the confirmation + cancel link.

attendee_name.description: Name of the guest being booked (the agent's principal).

attendee_notes.description: Pitch / context the host sees alongside the booking.

host_handle.description: The PitchIQ host's PUBLIC booking handle (e.g. from discover_search_podcasts). Books on THEIR public calendar, not yours.

start_at.description: Slot start (ISO-8601 UTC). Must be a currently-free slot on the host's calendar — re-checked before insert.

name: pitchiq_v1_booking_book_guest_slot

description: Return the workspace 'brain index' — every wiki page's title, slug, and one-line summary, in hierarchy order. Call this at the START of a session to learn what the workspace already knows before searching, asking the user, or creating anything. Requires an active workspace.
name: pitchiq_v1_brain_get_index

description: Traverse the workspace knowledge graph from a specific entity. For wiki_page: returns forward links, backlinks, 5 most similar pages, and CRM entity mentions found in the page text. For contact: returns linked deals, opportunities, tasks, outreach summary, conversation count, and wiki pages mentioning this contact. For deal: returns primary contact, tasks, bookings, conversation count, and wiki pages mentioning this deal. Use this to understand relationships and discover connected information across the workspace. Requires an active workspace.

entity_id.description: UUID of the entity to query.

entity_type.description: The type of entity to traverse from.

name: pitchiq_v1_brain_graph_query

description: Semantic search across the active workspace's wiki (the 'brain'). Finds pages by MEANING — it matches even when you use different words than the page does. Returns ranked pages (title, slug, summary). Prefer this over pitchiq_v1_wiki_search_pages when you don't know the exact wording. Requires an active workspace.

query.description: Natural-language query. Matches by meaning, not exact keywords.

name: pitchiq_v1_brain_search

description: Get a firm x402 price + payment requirements for any Commerce tool BEFORE committing — so an agent (or its spend policy) can budget. Returns the USD price, pricing class, network, and the x402 'accepts' block to construct the payment. x402-payable (read class).

tool_name.description: The Commerce tool to price (e.g. pitchiq_v1_booking_book_guest_slot). Call tools/list to see what's available.

name: pitchiq_v1_commerce_quote_action

description: Search PitchIQ's global Twitch/YouTube creator index by name, category, language, audience size, and whether they accept review keys — for an agent seeking creators to cover a game/product. Returns name, platform handles, followers, avg concurrent viewers, category, and top games. x402-payable; no PAT required.

accepts_keys.description: Only creators who accept review keys.

query.description: Free-text match on the creator's display name.

name: pitchiq_v1_discover_search_creators

description: Search PitchIQ's global Steam-curator index by name, tag, language, and audience size — for an agent marketing a game/product into a niche. Returns curator name, Steam URL, follower + review counts, and tags. x402-payable; no PAT required.

query.description: Free-text match on the curator's name.

name: pitchiq_v1_discover_search_curators

description: Search PitchIQ's podcast directory (ListenNotes-indexed). Returns matching shows with title, host, listener tier (small/mid/large), category, and cover image. Useful for finding podcasts an agent should pitch the user onto.

category.description: Filter by category (free-text; varies by source).

listener_tier.description: Filter by audience size bucket. PitchIQ tiers shows as small / mid / large.

name: pitchiq_v1_discover_search_podcasts
